coordinate_system: x rearward, y car-right outboard, z up; mm
probe_notes: Saved cell-center vectors interpolated linearly and averaged with positive rearward flux weighting. Angle is calculated from a weighted mean vector, not from individually averaged angles. Each physical comparison uses one shared fluid support across both geometries and both grids. At corresponding slot-relative samples, support is shared in normalized coordinates and integrated with each actual geometry's area element, not projected back to a fixed physical rectangle. Local percentiles of absolute pointwise angle changes and RMS velocity changes are unweighted by mass flux.
